title: The Blood of Dawnwalker
description: A dark fantasy RPG from ex-Witcher 3 developers where you're a reluctant vampire juggling mortal ties by day and predatory power by night across occupied Moravia.
fun_fact: Rebel Wolves was founded by former CD Projekt Red veterans who led The Witcher 3, and the day/night cycle here runs on a real countdown that keeps pressuring your choices.

title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
description: Capcom revives its demon-slaying samurai series with a new swordsman, the Oni gauntlet, and the same parry-heavy, blade-first combat that made the originals click.
fun_fact: It's the first new mainline Onimusha game since 2006's Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams.

title: Marvel's Wolverine
description: Insomniac's claws-out take on Logan, set in the same universe as their Spider-Man games, trades web-slinging for brutal, up-close brawling and a healing factor that shows on screen.
fun_fact: Wolverine's wounds visibly carve into his body and knit back together in real time mid-fight, tied directly to the healing-factor combat system.

title: BloomKeeper
description: A gentle real-time tactical adventure where you guide a colony of small magical creatures called Pouics to regrow a devastated island, solo or alongside a friend.
fun_fact: Full co-op is built in from the start, you can hand a second controller to someone and rebuild the island together.

title: Control Resonant
description: Remedy's sequel to Control sends Dylan Faden through a warped, paranatural Manhattan, wielding reality-bending powers against a cosmic threat.
fun_fact: It's a direct sequel to 2019's Control, and Remedy has said the same New Weird tone and architecture-as-horror style carries through into a whole new city.

title: Silent Hill: Townfall
description: A new Silent Hill story from developer No Code (Annapurna Interactive), trading the fog-choked town for a psychological descent into a Scottish counterpart to the series' signature dread.
fun_fact: It's a from-the-ground-up original story rather than a remake, the first fully new mainline Silent Hill narrative in years.

title: EA Sports FC 27
description: The annual soccer sim returns with The Grounds, an open-world street-football hub spanning Paris, Buenos Aires, and suburban Britain, alongside the usual club and Ultimate Team modes.
fun_fact: The Grounds is the first time the FC series has built an explorable open-world hub connecting its street-football modes.

title: Minecraft Dungeons II
description: The loot-driven dungeon crawler returns with new biomes, gear, and up to four-player co-op smashing through Minecraft's blocky underworld.
fun_fact: It launches day one in Xbox Game Pass, same as the original Dungeons did back in 2020.

title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave
description: A Switch 2 exclusive successor to Fire Emblem: Three Houses, mixing turn-based tactics with a branching academy-and-war narrative.
fun_fact: It's Intelligent Systems' first mainline Fire Emblem built from the ground up for Switch 2 hardware.

title: Planet Zoo 2
description: Frontier's zoo-building sim returns with aquariums and marine habitats added to the deep animal-care and park-design systems that made the first game a favorite for slow, creative sessions.
fun_fact: This is the franchise's first console release, Planet Zoo was PC-only for its entire first run.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
description: A pixel-art, boomstick-loud sequel to the retro Warhammer 40K shooter, throwing a Space Marine at hordes of heretics with chainswords, bolters, and no time to breathe.
fun_fact: A Switch 2 version is planned to follow shortly after the PC/PlayStation/Xbox launch.

title: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
description: Natsume's farming series returns with a fresh region to settle, crops to grow, and townsfolk to befriend at whatever pace you want to play.
fun_fact: It's Natsume's own Harvest Moon line rather than the Story of Seasons series Harvest Moon split from years ago, still built around the same easygoing farm-and-friends loop.

title: Phantom Blade Zero
description: A stylish wuxia action game from S-GAME blending fast, combo-heavy swordplay with a dark near-future take on ancient China.
fun_fact: It was delayed about seven weeks from its original September date so the team could polish the final act before launch.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI
description: Rockstar's long-awaited return to Vice City follows dual protagonists Jason and Lucia through a sprawling, satirical open world of crime and consequence.
fun_fact: It's Rockstar's first mainline GTA since 2013's GTA V, and launches PS5/Xbox Series X|S only at first.

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
description: Square Enix's monster-taming spin-off returns with a new world to explore, scout, and battle through, built around the classic Dragon Quest Monsters loop of collecting and breeding creatures.
fun_fact: It ships as a simultaneous worldwide release across Switch 2, Switch, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC.
